title: trema chichileum
intro: Trema chichileum, commonly known as the "Water Lemon", is a plant species in the family Salicaceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its reported health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, and aid in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Trema chichileum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Trema chichileum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
